Ten deliveries. One continuous flight.
Make every burn count.

01 LAUNCH→02 DOCK→03 DELIVER

Carry payloads from planetary landing pads to orbital relays. Cross the solar system, adapt to changing gravity, and keep fuel in the tank.

Start on Earth with a full tank and your first payload.

PRE-FLIGHT BRIEFING / CONTROLS

W / SPACE / ↑ Hold the main engine at 100%; release to coast.
A / D / ← / → Rotate; hold to turn gradually faster. K Brake with backward thrust relative to the rocket’s orientation.
W / A / S / D Double-tap within 250 ms to dash forward / left / backward / right relative to the rocket. Each dash costs 1% fuel; all directions share a 2-second cooldown.
E Attach when bay checks are green. ESC Save and menu.

Land upright on the next pad at ≤ 12 m/s to receive fuel and payload. Dock with the nose pointing UP (0°), within ±12°, and slow to ≤ 8 m/s. Surface impacts above 12 m/s through 25 m/s and station impacts below 30 m/s cause gentle bumps; slow down again before landing or attaching. Your bay is on the rocket’s right side. After delivering, use W main thrust to detach and clear the receiver before turning toward the next pad.

The motion dial shows drift direction and rocket rotation. The orange propulsion meter shows combined current fuel use; the green bar shows remaining fuel. The tank has half its original capacity. Each landing pad adds 25% of a tank, capped at full, once per route stop. Empty fuel or a high-speed collision ends the run. Leaving the page suspends and saves your flight.

This site logs anonymous clicks, choices, game actions, and timing for the owner. No names, passwords, or typed text are recorded.
